title: An interrupt in claim between taking the coord run state and the block that puts it back leaves the run state at claimed
goal: claim puts the coord run state back to released on an interrupt that lands right after it took the state, before the block that undoes it opens

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog, bl_items, bl_land
r = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(r), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init", "-q")
(r / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items"}))
(r / "items").mkdir()
item = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "t", "status": "todo", "priority": "P3", "goal": "g", "touches": ["x.txt"], "checks": [{"run": ["python3", "-c", "pass"]}]}
(r / "items" / "ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(item, indent=2) + "\n")
g("add", "-A")
g("-c", "user.name=x", "-c", "user.email=x@example.com", "commit", "-qm", "i")
real = bl_items.take_claim
def interrupt_after_take(*a, **k):
    out = real(*a, **k)
    raise KeyboardInterrupt
bl_items.take_claim = interrupt_after_take
os.environ["CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"] = "chk"
os.environ.pop("KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG", None)
try:
    backlog.main(["--root", str(r), "claim", "ST-aaaaaaaa", "--by", "w"])
except BaseException as e:
    print("claim ended with", type(e).__name__)
backlog.OUTPUT_ROOT[0] = str(r)
state = bl_land.run_state("ST-aaaaaaaa")
print("run state after an interrupt right after the state was taken:", repr(state))
sys.exit(0 if state in ("", "released") else 1)
